app_info.subtitle: Control OBS from ChatGPT
app_info.description: OBS Creator Assistant securely connects ChatGPT to a creator's own OBS Studio computer so they can inspect OBS, switch scenes, share a screen or window, run AI transitions, and execute creator-defined LIVE workflows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Pairs an unclaimed local OBS computer to the authenticated user's private account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private account-to-device ownership and does not publish or send public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data or revoke an existing device relationship.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves OBS computers owned by the authenticated user and their connection status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private account data and does not modify external or public systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, revoke, overwrite, or otherwise change device state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates a friendly name, production role, or default setting for one computer owned by the authenticated creator.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private account metadata and does not publish content or change OBS output.
justifications.destructive_justification: The settings are reversible and do not remove a computer or delete OBS resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores or updates private production metadata for two computers owned by the authenticated creator.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change OBS, TikTok LIVE Studio, or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete OBS resources and only updates a preset when its authenticated owner supplies its ID.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists dual-PC presets owned by the authenticated creator.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private account metadata without changing external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete presets, computers, or OBS resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads connection, scene, source, video, and Virtual Camera state from the two creator-owned computers in a saved preset.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change OBS or control TikTok LIVE Studio and does not publish content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Uses a fixed read-only local inspection and makes no configuration or output changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: After explicit confirmation, changes scenes and source visibility on two creator-owned OBS computers and starts OBS Virtual Camera on the assigned compositor computer.
justifications.open_world_justification: Controls private OBS production state but does not start a TikTok LIVE, publish content, or operate TikTok LIVE Studio.
justifications.destructive_justification: Captures prior state before changes and restores completed changes in reverse order if startup fails.

justifications.read_only_justification: After explicit confirmation, stops only the Virtual Camera started by the selected session and restores captured OBS scenes and source visibility.
justifications.open_world_justification: Controls private OBS state and does not end a TikTok LIVE or operate TikTok LIVE Studio.
justifications.destructive_justification: Restores previously captured state, records failures precisely, and does not delete OBS resources or audit records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists recent production sessions owned by the authenticated creator and their restoration status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private account audit data without changing OBS, TikTok, or public systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete production sessions or OBS resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads connection, OBS output, CPU, memory, FPS, render-lag, and encoding-lag snapshots from the two computers in a creator-owned production session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private OBS state without changing OBS, TikTok LIVE Studio, or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Dispatches only fixed read-only status and performance commands and does not modify production sessions or OBS resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: After explicit confirmation, switches an existing scene or changes one existing source's visibility on the computer assigned to a selected role in an active creator-owned session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Controls private OBS presentation state and does not operate TikTok LIVE Studio, start a TikTok LIVE, or publish content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Captures prior state, avoids duplicate commands, attempts immediate compensation after failure, and does not create or delete OBS resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves current OBS stream, recording, replay-buffer, and version status from the user's computer.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private local OBS state without changing public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change OBS configuration or output state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists scene information from the user's own OBS instance.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private local OBS configuration and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify scenes or sources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the active scene on the authenticated user's private OBS instance.
justifications.open_world_justification: Controls a private local production application and does not directly publish content to an external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Scene switching is reversible and does not delete or overwrite OBS resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves whether OBS Virtual Camera is available and active on the creator's selected computer.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private local OBS output state and does not publish content or change TikTok LIVE Studio.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change OBS Virtual Camera or any live output.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts OBS Virtual Camera only after explicit creator confirmation so TikTok LIVE Studio can receive the composed OBS video.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes a private local OBS output and does not start a TikTok LIVE or publish to the internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: The action is reversible and does not delete scenes, sources, media, or account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stops OBS Virtual Camera only after explicit creator confirmation that TikTok LIVE Studio no longer needs the feed.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes a private local OBS output and does not end or otherwise control a TikTok LIVE.
justifications.destructive_justification: The action is reversible and does not delete scenes, sources, media, or account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Plays a user-selected three-part media sequence and changes temporary OBS presentation state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the user's private OBS instance and does not itself publish to a public platform.
justifications.destructive_justification: The workflow restores the prior LIVE scene and does not delete media or scenes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes OBS source visibility and layout to show an existing screen or window capture source.
justifications.open_world_justification: Controls private OBS presentation state and does not directly send data to a public service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite sources and the creator can return to the previous scene.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes creator-defined OBS actions such as scene changes, media playback, source visibility, timing, and audio changes.
justifications.open_world_justification: The allowlisted workflow operates on the authenticated user's private OBS instance rather than public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: The exposed workflow action set does not delete OBS scenes, sources, media, or account data.

test_cases.description: Pair a newly installed creator computer using its six-digit code.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms that the matching unclaimed OBS computer was paired to the authenticated account or clearly reports an invalid or expired code.

test_cases.description: Check whether the creator's OBS computer is connected and ready.
test_cases.user_prompt: Is my OBS connected and am I currently streaming?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current OBS connection and output status for the creator's owned computer.

test_cases.description: Switch to an existing OBS scene.
test_cases.user_prompt: Switch my OBS to the Battle scene.
test_cases.expected_output: Switches the creator's OBS program scene to Battle and confirms the change.

test_cases.description: Check and prepare OBS Virtual Camera for use as the camera source in TikTok LIVE Studio.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check my OBS virtual camera, then ask me before starting it for TikTok LIVE Studio.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the current OBS Virtual Camera state, requests explicit confirmation before starting it, and clearly states that starting the virtual camera does not start a TikTok LIVE.

test_cases.description: Run the flagship three-part AI transition workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run my AI transition using Transition In, Dragon Video, and Transition Out on my Media scene.
test_cases.expected_output: Runs the three media clips in order and returns the creator to the prior LIVE scene, or safely reports a media failure.

test_cases.description: Prepare a saved two-computer production only after confirmation, then restore it after the creator finishes in TikTok LIVE Studio.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare Weekend LIVE on both OBS computers. Ask me before changing anything or starting Virtual Camera. Later, restore both computers after I confirm the TikTok LIVE has ended.
test_cases.expected_output: Performs a read-only preflight, asks for explicit confirmation, applies ordered creator-owned OBS changes, verifies Virtual Camera, never claims TikTok is live, and restores recorded state after a separate confirmed stop request.

test_cases.description: Save and inspect a creator-owned two-computer TikTok production without changing either OBS instance.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save these Background and Camera computers as Weekend LIVE, then check whether both scenes, my Background Feed source, 1080x1920 at 30 FPS, and OBS Virtual Camera are ready without changing anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Stores only creator-owned device references, performs a read-only check on both computers, reports per-computer issues, and distinguishes OBS readiness from readiness for TikTok preview.

test_cases.description: Inspect both computers in an active dual-PC production for OBS performance problems.
test_cases.user_prompt: Is either OBS computer dropping frames or running too slowly during Weekend LIVE?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns separate connection, output, CPU, memory, FPS, render-lag, and encoding-lag results for both creator-owned computers without changing OBS or claiming the transport-independent video signal was verified.

test_cases.description: Apply a role-specific scene or source-visibility change during an active dual-PC production.
test_cases.user_prompt: During Weekend LIVE, change the Background computer to Neon City after I confirm, then hide the Lower Third on the Camera computer after a separate confirmation.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the active session's saved role-to-device mapping, requests explicit confirmation, captures prior state, changes only the selected role, never controls TikTok LIVE Studio, and reports whether compensation or manual attention was required.

test_cases.description: Share an existing window capture with camera picture-in-picture.
test_cases.user_prompt: Share my Chrome capture on the Screen Share scene and keep my camera picture-in-picture.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the requested capture source with the camera picture-in-picture on the creator's OBS instance.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke OBS tools for general streaming advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What makes a good livestream introduction?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers normally without accessing OBS because the user asked for advice rather than an OBS action or inspection.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke OBS tools for unrelated computer controls.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Close Chrome and restart my computer.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke the app because operating system process and restart controls are outside its allowlisted OBS capabilities.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use a creator's account to control another creator's device.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Switch the scene on my friend's OBS computer even though it is not paired to my account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses or explains that OBS Creator Assistant can only access computers paired to the authenticated user's account.
